name: GPU Voxelization via Projection and Bitmasking
definition: A GPU-based voxelization technique that rasterizes triangles into a 3D voxel grid using a bitmask representation. It projects triangles onto 2D planes, tests voxel occupancy against triangle edges using plane equations, and updates a 32-bit integer bitmask per voxel to represent occupancy along the depth axis (Z).
